proposal.expected_benefit: This will strengthen the confidence in the decision to escalate by ensuring that all required signals are not only detected but also verified and resolved.
proposal.problem: The defense correctly identifies the need for escalation but fails to provide evidence that the required signals (independent verification and governance) have been fulfilled.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a strategy to explicitly verify the presence and resolution of required signals (independent verification and governance) before making any escalation decisions. This includes cross-referencing evidence references with the required signals to ensure completeness and correctness.
proposal.title: Ensure Verification of Required Signals in Defense
verification_tests: Check if all required signals are explicitly verified in the defense output.
Ensure that evidence references are mapped to the required signals for completeness.
